## The problem

Write what you want to do and why the gem does not let you do it now.

## Your proposal

Write the code that you want to write. For example:

```ruby
FeedbackPilgrim.posts.create(title: "Add dark mode", content: "Please add a dark theme.")
```

## Other solutions

Write the other solutions that you tried.
